meta.description: Clinical reference and decision-support workspace for urologists and andrologists.

search.hint: Type to search modules and sections.
search.scopeNote: Search currently covers modules and sections. Topics, lab parameters and guidelines are added in phase 5.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeText: Structured clinical reference for urology and andrology. Open a module, search a topic, or continue where you left off.
dashboard.recentEmpty: Modules you open will appear here.
dashboard.bookmarksEmpty: Bookmark a module to keep it here.
dashboard.contentStatusText: Clinical content is being written and medically reviewed separately. Sections show their review status until approved content is published.

modules.title: Clinical modules
modules.intro: Five independent modules with a consistent structure.

male-infertility.title: Male Infertility
male-infertility.description: History, examination, semen analysis, hormonal and genetic evaluation, diagnostic pathway and treatment.

erectile-dysfunction.title: Erectile Dysfunction
erectile-dysfunction.description: Classification, anamnesis, cardiovascular risk, laboratory work-up, IIEF-5 and treatment options.

premature-ejaculation.title: Premature Ejaculation
premature-ejaculation.description: Lifelong and acquired forms, diagnostic criteria, IELT, PEDT and evidence-based treatment.

hypogonadism.title: Male Hypogonadism
hypogonadism.description: Primary and secondary forms, hormonal diagnostics, treatment decisions and fertility implications.

clinical-assessment.title: Clinical Assessment
clinical-assessment.description: Integrated workflow: initial assessment, examination, test selection, decision trees and referral.

status.pendingReviewText: This section has no approved content yet. It will be published after review by a qualified physician, with sources and version.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageText: Clinical content is published separately for each language after verified translation.
settings.dataText: Only bookmarks, recently opened modules and the sidebar state are stored in this browser. No patient data is stored.

disclaimer.short: For qualified healthcare professionals. Educational and reference use only; not a substitute for clinical judgement. No diagnosis or prescribing is made by this platform.

content.translationBehind: This translation is behind the original version. Check the original for recent changes.
content.draftBanner: Draft preview: not medically reviewed. Visible only in preview builds.
content.requiresReviewBanner: Parts of this content could not be verified and require review.
content.otherLanguages: Not yet available in this language. Verified versions exist in:
content.parametersNote: Reference limits, units and the WHO edition are shown here once a reviewed dataset is published.
content.rangeNotApproved: This reference dataset is not approved yet.
content.statusIntro: Review state of every section and topic, by language. Only approved content is shown without a warning.

content.relatedModulesText: Clinical assessment brings together the history, examination and test selection from these modules.
